headline: DET @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.90 at CHW 4.30, with a projected total of 8.20. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: DET moved -0.67 runs while CHW moved -0.19, changing the projected margin by -0.47 runs. The projected total fell -0.85, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Keider Montero has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Kevin McGonigle, Sam Antonacci, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach McKinstry, Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
